title: Auto scale gitlab runner using AWS spot instance

img.caption: Auto scale gitlab runner using AWS spot instance, AI generated image

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: Gitlab runner auto scaling for CI / CD pipeline using AWS EC2 is a great option to spawn the instances based on the number of jobs that needs to scheduled. Understanding this article requires the reader to have basic understanding of gitlab and AWS.
Reader can follow the reference links to setup the AWS instance network, security policies. Also keep your amazonec2-access-key, amazonec2-secret-key ready.

sections.heading: Configuring gitlab runner instance in AWS
paragraphs: First, install Gitlab Runner, Docker and Docker Machine into the AWS EC2 t2.micro instance. This instance will work as an instance manager which will start new machines.
Once the prerequisite packages are installed, test whether the docker machine creates new machines by executing below script.
Copy the SSH key .pem file to the gitlab runner instance.
Generate a public key file using this .pem file, as machine option amazonec2-ssh-keypath will also require the public key to be available in the folder.

     IdleCountMin = 0
